verdict.rationale: The product is a skill pack that plugs into existing agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot), and it ships no assistant of its own. Within those hosts, users delegate concrete tasks with slash commands: spec writing, ticket splitting, test-first building, diff review, bug diagnosis and merge-conflict resolution. Triage also produces agent-ready briefs labelled for an AFK agent. Missing for 10: an AI assistant built into the product itself rather than a required third-party host agent, and hands-on corroboration that the delegated workflows work as described.
